meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把指定的 Linear 团队接成一个对话渠道。配置完成后,该团队 issue 的每条新评论会自动触发 Claude 回帖,无需 @ 提及;每个 issue 的评论线程是一段独立对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 或项目接入 Linear 频道,或在 /setup 流程中选择 Linear 时由它执行;配置好后,该团队 issue 的新评论也会自动触发回复。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Linear,issue 评论都自动回。
say.note: 会触发 add-linear 的接入配置流程。

say.text: 用 OAuth 应用给项目配一个 Linear 频道。
继续 /setup,我要添加 Linear 渠道。
say.note: 执行后续 webhook、凭据和团队绑定步骤。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can connect a chosen Linear team as a conversation channel. After setup, every new comment on that team's issues triggers a reply in the thread, no @-mention needed; each issue comment thread is treated as a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Runs when the user asks to add Linear to NanoClaw or a project, or chooses Linear during /setup. After configuration, new comments on that team's issues also trigger replies automatically.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to Linear and auto-reply to issue comments.
Set up a Linear channel for this project with an OAuth app.
say_en.note: You'll be asked for OAuth Client ID and Secret.

say_en.text: Continue /setup; I want to add the Linear channel.
say_en.note: Continues webhook, credential, and team wiring steps.
